description: Mcp update kit. The complete server-update methodology: protocol version negotiation rules, a versioning discipline that never reuses a number, the add-evolve-deprecate-remove ladder with lead times, client caching and refresh behavior for tools and descriptions, the registry and server-card re-publish path, and a zero-regression verification pass with rollback. One call returns the full kit; the buyer's agent updates its own MCP server without breaking clients. Price: $10.00 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
